releases.notes:
Nine Relic Blades

Nine Relic Blades adds nine legendary swords to Minecraft Fabric 1.20.1. Every relic has a custom pixel-art texture, a unique right-click ability, a combat passive, a magical particle trail, sound effects, and its own survival crafting recipe.
Relics

    Flameheart — Ignite enemies and unleash a flame surge.
    Frostreign — Freeze and slow your enemies.
    Stormcaller — Call lightning onto the battlefield.
    Voidrend — Leap through the void and blind targets.
    Venomroot — Spread poison and withering effects.
    Bloodmoon — Harvest health from combat.
    Suncrest — Gain powerful solar strength.
    Moonshade — Hide beneath a moonlit veil.
    Starbreaker — Release random cosmic relic effects.

Requirements

    Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1
    Fabric Loader
    Fabric API

Install the mod and Fabric API in your mods folder on both the client and server.
